title: Implement bounded GCC 13 prefix visit ordering
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Implements the conditional GCC 13.3 for_each_path visit-order primitive, preserving machine-suffix policies 0/1/2, separate compiler/OS multilib skip states, null/empty/dot distinctions, multiarch order, duplicate visits and literal spellings. Bounds stop with an explicit frontier before oversized concatenation.

This is an individually completed prerequisite component in the original compiler-input closure and the full named bootstrap-control campaign assignment. **Complete compiler-input closure, complete bootstrap-control campaign, effective configuration, original execution and runtime qualification remain open.** No performance or κ gain is claimed.

## Task and overlap

Original source investigation: [PR #6321](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6321). Frozen H25 benchmark: [PR #6029](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6029). Immediate predecessors: [PR #6362](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6362), [PR #6363](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6363).

Task-card scope is changed to this concrete code increment; the user-assigned original compiler-input closure and the full bootstrap-control campaign completion criteria are unchanged. Base `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`; published head `ea96ac0f9eaddd677226680963d3784922549af2`; tree `04fe6f937461d7ef78c59a988cad97b41a96afd6` matches byte-checked local commit `fbc54cd96deee938412c3f074c6aa5b4d6482f9e`. 19 new files, one commit.

Canonical investigation #6321. #6362 (`120072d58ddb46f0e02886756243174d41fce42e`) provides the earlier partial input-edge/source/data helpers. #6363 (`a8cf650b7435ccea237084e491e339f725c0a35b`) provides exact parent/domain compatibility findings and the bounded related-PR graph. This adds the reviewed implementation and cold inputs for its named scope; it does not replace the original activity with a finite test.

```sh
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/h25-gcc-prefix-order --check-only
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/h25-gcc-prefix-order
python3 scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/h25-gcc-prefix-order
```

22 independently tabulated new fixture methods passed in normal Python and -O. Independent Sol Max source review checked both retained C bodies and exact frozen identities; cross-export review accepted the unchanged code/test and thin runner.

Registered replay uses only new code and committed inert source/data inputs. No original module, Root/provider/parent, compiler/native target, namespace or scientific workload runs. Actual hosted checks will be recorded after submission, bound to this exact head.

No filesystem query/access consumer, file selection, effective prefix construction or installed-compiler equivalence is established. The optional full source-comparison utility requires the exact 162-input PR6362 corpus; it is outside registered replay. The retained C snippets differ by one Ubuntu allocation-margin line, without changed visit ordering.
